description: ABB free@home SysAP — policy-only module for firewall rules (no VM)
_comment_zoning: ADR-COM-0006: SysAP, deconz and hue are co-located in iotCloud. The SysAP consumes deconz:bridge and hue:bridge INTRA-zone (native SSDP/mDNS discovery + control, no cross-zone relay, no egress-to-iotLocal). deconz:bridge and hue:bridge are interchangeable Hue-bridge providers (same capability name). HA remains a redundant secondary controller via its own srvHome->iotCloud pinhole.
